suggestions.topic: Sepolia Glamsterdam fork status and client readiness
suggestions.rationale: Sepolia fork scheduled for October 6 (in 5 days). Critical to confirm all clients are ready, monitoring is in place, and no blocking issues emerged from final testing.

suggestions.topic: Devnet-8 JUMPDEST attack retest results (without debug tracing)
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #98 decided to disable debug tracing and rerun Paweł's and Jochem's attacks to isolate tracing overhead. Results are critical for the gas repricing decision and validating 200M gas safety.
ACDT #97 set October 8 as the go/no-go decision date for Hoodi (tentatively October 27). With that date only a week away, the decision should be confirmed or updated.

suggestions.topic: FCR 'confirmed' block tag async discussion outcomes
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #98 tasked Julian Ma with opening an async thread on execution-apis #908. If discussion has progressed, summarize feedback and next steps for opt-in FCR implementation.

suggestions.topic: Hegota devnet planning: FOCIL-only and Frames-only progress
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #97 decided on separate FOCIL and Frames devnets before combining. With a target to launch combined devnet before DevCon, updates on standalone devnet progress would inform timeline.

suggestions.topic: BAL retention and CL serving window alignment
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #97 deferred this to async discussion and ACDE. While not blocking Sepolia, it affects EIP-7928 retention logic and EIP-8061/8383 serving window choices for future forks.

suggestions.topic: Mainnet shadow fork readiness and timeline
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #98 mentioned mainnet shadow fork in ~1.5–2 weeks (mid-October). Confirm client readiness, scope (Snap2 testing, ePBS stress testing), and scheduling.

suggestions.topic: EIP-8411 (Fast Execution Payload Broadcast) CL team ratings update
suggestions.rationale: ACDT #97 asked CL teams to add ratings ahead of the next ACDC. While this is an ACDC topic, a quick ACDT update could inform upcoming ACDC discussions.
